To hide? (\textbf{nascondere}.) To show? (\textbf{mostrare}.) To look at? (\textbf{guardare}.) To phone? (\textbf{telefonare}.) To discuss? (\textbf{discutere}.) To quarrel? (\textbf{litigare}.)
